fill-time field (weighted geodesic from the sprue, wall lag, slower in cavities) run backward; meniscus boil on twos + Whitney oscillator bank; Beer-Lambert thickness colour; refraction of F-steel; light spill; specular; raking key; perspective camera glide and focus pull (melt.py)

all sound synthesized in shot.py with kit.Mix: room/hum, 8 viscous syllable pulses (L3 syllables 5-12), four cavity-release suctions at simulated times, falling drain tone with gurgle, sprue glug at 26.20, granular pellet rain 26.80-27.60

declared_substitutions: The glow of the melt is a lighting choice (pigmented plastic lit through by a warm source reflected from the polished cavity floor); molten polystyrene does not visibly glow.

The cavity bore is eccentric, inherited from the oblique view of the ring in the runner photograph (rectified by y/0.94 only), so that the hollow matches the Sh2 cutout silhouette; a real tool's bore would be concentric (concentric version measured IoU 0.83).
